name: Junior Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Spend one 4 to 5 hour shift a week at the hospital through the summer. Juniors do things like escorting patients and delivering items. Older adult volunteers work with you and mentor you.
who_can_apply: Any high school student who has finished freshman year.
duration: One shift a week from June orientation to the end of July
deadline_text: Last cycle's pattern: names taken in April, interviews in May, orientation in June, program ends end of July. 35 students took part in 2025.
how_to_apply: The volunteer office takes names in April, according to a November 2025 article. The article gives no form or phone number for the junior program. The hospital main phone is 760-340-3911.
notes: Confirm first: the dates come from a November 2025 article, not a program page. The Volunteers page does not mention the junior program, and the number 760-773-1304 appears on it with no label.
